do.text: In a form, use a date field: it shows the picked day and opens the calendar only when needed.

dont.text: Don't put a whole month in a form for one date: it takes the screen and hides what was picked.

title: Rule out what cannot be picked

do.text: Set `minDate`, `maxDate` and `isUnavailable` so days that cannot be booked cannot be tapped.

dont.text: Don't let people tap a past day and only then tell them it has passed.
